title: Folks Ain't Roadblocks
evidence_boundary: The town-play and resistance-band language is metaphor for examining one's reactions and boundaries. It is not a claim that a person created, controls, or spiritually assigned other people.
desired_movement: From treating people as enemies blocking peace to examining what encounters reveal while preserving boundaries and other people's autonomy.
grounding: The episode returns to June's porch, Earl, two squirrels, and one pecan.
invitation: When somebody disturbs your peace, what role are they revealing—and what role are you choosing next?
